days.breakfast: Protein shake: 1 scoop Levels whey + 12 oz 2% milk + 1 cup blueberries. Chai masala tea and water are not counted unless milk/sugar is added.
days.meal1: Caesar salad + rotisserie chicken + eggs: half Costco Caesar kit, light dressing, no croutons, 8 oz rotisserie chicken breast, 2 boiled eggs.
days.meal2: Air-fried tilapia plate: 10 oz tilapia, 1 cup cooked rice, 1 steamed vegetable serving, 1 tbsp olive oil.
days.prep: Boil eggs ahead. Pull rotisserie breast meat and portion 8 oz. Cook tilapia fresh or batch cook two portions.

days.breakfast: Protein shake: 1 scoop whey + 12 oz 2% milk + blueberries.
days.meal1: Chicken skewer bowl: 4 Costco chicken skewers, 1 cup rice, 1 steamed vegetable serving, 1 cup Greek yogurt sauce, half avocado.
days.meal2: Shrimp Caesar: 8 oz cooked shrimp, half Caesar kit, 2 boiled eggs, half avocado. Keep dressing light.
days.prep: Use Greek yogurt with lemon/garlic/hot sauce as sauce. Keep shrimp cold and assemble salad right before eating.

days.breakfast: Protein shake: 1 scoop whey + 12 oz 2% milk + blueberries.

days.breakfast: Weekend kefir protein shake: 2 cups plain kefir + 1 scoop whey + 1 cup frozen berries.
days.meal1: Raw vegetable plate through the day: cucumbers, mini peppers, carrots, or similar Costco produce.
days.meal2: Fruit through the day: 3 servings total such as apple, orange, berries, melon, or grapes.
days.prep: This is intentionally fasting-adjacent. Do not force weekday calories unless energy, sleep, or adherence suffers.
